_platform: OpenIPC / Goke GK7205V200 / IMX307 -- our venc + isp_ctl on :9600 (no DVRIP, no ONVIF)
_notes: Science config for OpenIPC-converted cameras. Control goes to the isp_ctl daemon on :9600 via Utils/CameraControl's OpenIPC path (openipcCall). DVRIP setup verbs are mapped: CameraTime->time set, SetAutoReboot->autoreboot(cron), SetParam Encode*->encode(venc.conf+bounce), Camera PictureFlip/Mirror->flip/mirror, Camera DayNightColor->ircut, Camera WhiteBalance->wb, SetOSD/CloudConnection->ack. Isp commands are channel-less (venc is VENC chn 1, auto-detected). Encode params match the values baked into S96venc, so replaying them causes no venc bounce. Deploy as camera_settings.json on OpenIPC stations, or set config camera_settings_path to this file.
